description: Nairobi Motorcycle Transit Comparison Dataset: Fuel vs. Electric Vehicle Performance Tracking (2023) is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Mendeley Data. This dataset contains GPS tracking data and performance metrics for motorcycle taxis (boda bodas) in Nairobi, Kenya, comparing traditional internal combustion engine (ICE) motorcycles with electric motorcycles. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Mendeley Data. Its tags are Motorcycle, Transportation in Africa, Electric Vehicles. The repository dates the deposit 2025; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and electrification planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
